title: LISM laws on real regulatory filings, and the STRATIFIED RELATIVE FLOOR banking fix tested on the recovered N=992 (pre-registered and hash-locked BEFORE any gate was computed)
two_arms: ARM F tests the LISM laws on a new real substrate -- corporate regulatory filings via the FinancialReports connector. ARM T tests the proposed remedy for the anti-selection failure: replacing the flat fidelity floor with capacity-stratified relative floors. The arms are locked together because both were specified before either was run.
why_arm_T_exists: The prescriptive banking design failed on the recovered N=992 cohort (3/5, spec 00d5d277). The mechanism was identified: a flat D >= D_min admission rule ANTI-SELECTS, because in that cohort fidelity is inversely related to capacity (rho = -0.4702) and capacity dominates survival. Nodes clearing the flat floor had median 935 stars and defaulted at 89.9%; nodes below it had median 16,807 stars and defaulted at 54.0%. The proposed remedy is to stop comparing a corner shop against a conglomerate: segment applicants into capacity tiers and enforce a RELATIVE fidelity floor within each tier, so large nodes cannot coast on prestige and small nodes are not asked to carry a giant's structural overhead.
the_synthetic_evidence_problem_stated_up: IMPORTANT AND DELIBERATE. The stratified remedy currently rests on a simulator that GENERATES a synthetic population of 992 nodes with the capacity-fidelity correlation (rho ~ -0.47) DEliberately ENFORCED, and then demonstrates that stratification helps. That is not evidence. A population constructed to contain the structure a fix exploits will always show the fix working; this is the same pattern already refused twice in this repository -- the synthetic N=992 'restoration' and the seeded digital swarm. The remedy is therefore tested here on the REAL, recovered, verified N=992 cohort, where the correlation was measured rather than imposed. Whatever the simulator reported carries zero weight in this pre-registration.
the_hardest_gate_named_in_advance: T2 is the make-or-break gate. It is NOT enough for the stratified floor to beat the flat floor -- the flat floor is already known to be catastrophic, so beating it is a low bar and passing T1 alone would prove almost nothing. The design only earns its complexity if the stratified book also beats the SIMPLE CONVENTIONAL BASELINE of selecting on capacity alone. The proponent's own simulator reports it does NOT (72.0% stratified vs 60.0% conventional). If T2 fails on real data as well, the honest conclusion is that stratification mitigates a self-inflicted wound without producing any advantage over doing nothing clever, and that must be reported as such rather than presented as a 'protection shield'.

arm_T_data.cohort: data/github/govphys_quadratic_results.csv -- the recovered N=992 pre-registered GitHub cohort (spec cac34f44), verified by recomputation from its rows (cohort-audit/verify_992_recovery.py, 7/7). Committed.
arm_T_data.outcome: default = (E == 0). Lifecycle failure, measured independently of both capacity and fidelity, so non-circular with respect to every predictor.
arm_T_data.U: stars (capacity/status). D: the committed two-hop product D_enc * D_dec. tau_v: enforcement latency in days.
arm_T_data.imputation_handling: PRIMARY analysis on MEASURED-ONLY rows (tau_v_imputed == 0), because the cohort's imputation is asymmetric (15.5% of failed vs 4.1% of performing). Full sample reported as SECONDARY; on disagreement the measured-only result governs.
arm_T_data.tiers: Capacity QUARTILES by stars, fixed at 4 tiers. Within each tier the relative floor is the TIER-LOCAL 40th percentile of D -- the same quantile rule as the flat floor, applied locally. Both are outcome-free and fixed before running.

arm_T_gates.T1_stratified_beats_flat_floor: The stratified book's default rate must be strictly lower than the flat-floor book's. PASS iff strictly lower. CAN FAIL. DECLARED LOW-VALUE: the flat floor is already known to anti-select, so this gate is a sanity check, not a demonstration of merit.
arm_T_gates.T2_stratified_beats_conventional_baselin: MAKE-OR-BREAK. The stratified book's default rate must be strictly lower than a conventional book selected on capacity alone (top stars), at equal book size. PASS iff strictly lower. FALSIFIABLE AND AT GENUINE RISK -- the proponent's own simulation says this fails. If it fails here the design has no advantage over the naive baseline and must be reported as not earning its complexity.
arm_T_gates.T3_stratified_tail_is_better: Bootstrap each book 2000 times (seed 42) and compare the 95th percentile of the default-rate distribution. PASS iff the stratified book's 95th percentile is strictly below the conventional book's. CAN FAIL.
arm_T_gates.T4_capacity_access_is_preserved: The stratified book's median capacity must exceed the flat-floor book's -- i.e. stratification really does restore access to larger nodes rather than merely relabelling the same selection. PASS iff strictly greater. DECLARED: this is close to construction-favoured, since tier-local floors admit high-capacity nodes by design, so it is reported as SUPPORTING and never as independent confirmation.
arm_T_gates.T5_within_tier_fidelity_actually_discrim: THE MECHANISM GATE. Stratified floors are only coherent if, WITHIN a capacity tier, higher fidelity really does mean lower default. For each tier with both outcomes present, compute AUC(-D -> default) (lower D predicting default). PASS iff the sample-weighted AUC across usable tiers > 0.55 AND at least 2 tiers are usable. CAN FAIL, and a failure means the tier-local floor is sorting on a quantity that carries no within-tier information -- which would invalidate the remedy at its root regardless of T1-T4.

arm_F_data.source: FinancialReports connector (regulatory filings for listed companies: SEC, ESMA, ASX and others).
arm_F_data.tau_v: ENFORCEMENT LATENCY = days between fiscal period_end_date and the filing's release_datetime for annual reports (10-K / 10-K-ESEF). This is the institution's own latency in discharging a mandatory reporting obligation -- the closest real-economy analogue to issue-close latency, and it is measured, not self-reported.
arm_F_data.U: capacity = total assets or revenue from the standardized financials, reporting currency recorded alongside and never aggregated across currencies without conversion.
arm_F_data.D_enc: filing regularity = 1/(1 + stdev of filing latency across available years). Uses no outcome field.
arm_F_data.D_dec: disclosure completeness = share of the expected annual filing-type set actually present (10-K/ESEF, MDA, AR, CGR). Uses no outcome field.
arm_F_data.outcome: DISTRESS = the company has a DLST (Delisting Announcement) filing, or ceases filing annual reports for two consecutive years while remaining listed. This is a lifecycle failure measured from filing behaviour rather than from any predictor, so it is non-circular.

arm_F_gates.F0_connector_returns_data: The connector must actually return company and filing records. PASS iff a cohort of at least 60 companies with computable filing latency is retrieved AND COMMITTED as CSV. CAN FAIL -- and at lock time it is KNOWN TO BE FAILING: every live endpoint returns HTTP 403 'User profile not found for the provided token', because the FinancialReports account is not linked to the signed-in identity. This is recorded as a BLOCKED gate, not silently skipped and not substituted with generated data.
arm_F_gates.F1_latency_is_real_and_varies: Filing latency must be computable and non-degenerate: at least 60 companies, interquartile range > 5 days. CAN FAIL.
arm_F_gates.F2_third_law_on_filings: THE CENTRAL LISM CLAIM ON THIS SUBSTRATE. Distressed companies must show HIGHER mean filing latency than non-distressed ones, with AUC(tau_v -> distress) > 0.55. FALSIFIABLE BOTH WAYS: if slow filers are no more likely to fail, the Third Law does not transfer to regulated financial reporting and that is a reportable null.
arm_F_gates.F3_channel_independence: VIF(D_enc, D_dec) < 5.0 on the real filing cohort, with a circular control (D_dec copied from D_enc) rejected at VIF >= 5.0. CAN FAIL.
arm_F_gates.F4_linear_not_quadratic: Compare R2 of distress-risk on U*D against U*D^2. PASS iff linear >= quadratic. CAN FAIL. Reported with both R2 values; if both are near zero the honest statement is that neither coupling explains distress, never that one 'won'.

symmetric_null: Every AUC, VIF, rate, quantile and R2 is reported with its exact value whether or not it favours the design. T2 and T5 are the gates that matter and both are at genuine risk. A blocked arm is reported as BLOCKED with its exact HTTP error; it is never filled in with synthetic, simulated or remembered data, and a blocked gate counts as NOT MET rather than as absent. No threshold in this file may move after the lock.
what_a_pass_would_not_mean: Passing arm T would establish that capacity-stratified relative floors outperform both a flat floor and a naive capacity baseline on ONE real substrate of software repositories with lifecycle outcomes. It would NOT establish that the intermediary is profitable, that it survives competition with leveraged institutions, that repository dynamics transfer to human borrowers or credit markets, or that any normative or theological claim is correct.
acceptance: GREEN when this spec re-hashes to its published canonical SHA-256, the N=992 cohort re-hashes to the sha256 recorded by the recovery verification, and every gate is evaluated exactly as written -- with misses and blocked arms recorded, asserted in tests, and carried into the README. Exit 0 means 'reproduces including its failures and its blocked arm', never 'the design is validated'.
